title: Standalone browser-only release
summary: The finance tracker now runs entirely in the browser as an installable PWA.
changes: The home dashboard now opens with a stronger salon snapshot, clearer revenue language, and cleaner monthly activity panels.
The analytics dashboard was redesigned with a more polished hero, stronger highlight cards, and clearer chart groupings.
Data, service history, product sales, products, services, and workers pages now share a more cohesive workspace layout with clearer summaries and tables.
